rationale: The current best win came from keeping the recurrent final block's QKV out of int8, but the late EMA still averages those rescued QKV weights together with exact-FP32 control tensors such as tail_recur_gates before save. That smoothing is useful for lossy tensors, but it can blunt late-stage recurrent specialization on tensors that are already preserved accurately. This patch narrows EMA tracking to lossy non-QKV float-kept tensors plus the existing projection weights, so the recurrent tail attention path and exact control state stay at their final trained values while the quant-aware/projection stabilizer remains intact.
title: Preserve Recurrent Tail Controls And QKV From EMA Finalizer
